movelist.name: Charm
movelist.effect: Charm lowers the target’s Attack 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Struggle Bug
movelist.effect: On hit, lowers the target’s Special Attack by -1 CS.

movelist.name: Sweet Scent
movelist.effect: Targets hit by Sweet Scent gain a -2 Penalty to Evasion. (Total Evasion may not be lowered to a negative value. )

movelist.name: Play Nice
movelist.effect: Play Nice lowers the target’s Attack by 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Moonlight
movelist.effect: The user regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Point value. If it is Sunny, the user gains 2/3 of its full Hit Point value. If it is Rainy, Sand Storming or Hailing the user gains 1/4 of their full Hit Point value.

abilities.name: Oblivious
abilities.effect: The user is immune to the Enraged and Infatuated conditions. Defensive.

abilities.name: Aroma Veil
abilities.effect: The user and all adjacent Pokémon and Trainers cannot become Confused, Enraged, or Suppressed. Defensive.
